mapper.select: SELECT dd.dish_id AS dishId, COALESCE(d.dish_name, CONCAT('菜品#', dd.dish_id)) AS dishName, COALESCE(MAX(dc.category_name), '未分类') AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(dd.sales_quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(dd.gross_sales_amount), 0) AS grossSales, COALESCE(SUM(dd.net_sales_amount), 0) AS netSales, CASE WHEN SUM(dd.unknown_cost_quantity) = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(dd.cost_amount), 0) ELSE NULL END AS costAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(dd.unknown_cost_quantity) = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(dd.gross_profit_amount), 0) ELSE NULL END AS grossProfit, COALESCE(SUM(dd.order_count), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(dd.gift_quantity), 0) AS giftQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(dd.unknown_cost_quantity), 0) AS unknownCostQuantity, MAX(CASE WHEN dd.sales_quantity > 0 THEN dd.biz_date END) AS lastSaleDate FROM analysis_store_dish_daily dd INNER JOIN store_info s ON s.id = dd.store_id LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = dd.dish_id LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON dc.id = dd.category_id WHERE dd.biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND GROUP BY dd.dish_id, d.dish_name

SELECT sd.dish_id AS dishId, d.dish_name AS dishName, COALESCE(MAX(dc.category_name), '未分类') AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(dd.sales_quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(dd.net_sales_amount), 0) AS netSales, MAX(CASE WHEN dd.sales_quantity > 0 THEN dd.biz_date END) AS lastSaleDate FROM store_dish sd INNER JOIN store_info s ON s.id = sd.store_id INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = sd.dish_id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.master_status = 1 LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON dc.id = COALESCE(sd.category_override_id, d.category_id) LEFT JOIN analysis_store_dish_daily dd ON dd.store_id = sd.store_id AND dd.dish_id = sd.dish_id AND dd.biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.listing_status = 1 AND GROUP BY sd.dish_id, d.dish_name ORDER BY salesQuantity ASC, netSales ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName FROM store_info s WHERE ORDER BY s.store_name, s.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sd.dish_id AS dishId, sd.store_id AS storeId, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.listing_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS listed, COALESCE(SUM(dd.sales_quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(dd.net_sales_amount), 0) AS netSales, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(dd.unknown_cost_quantity), 0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(dd.gross_profit_amount), 0) ELSE NULL END AS grossProfit, COALESCE(SUM(dd.order_count), 0) AS dishOrderCount, COALESCE(MAX(store_orders.storeOrderCount), 0) AS storeOrderCount FROM store_dish sd INNER JOIN store_info s ON s.id = sd.store_id LEFT JOIN analysis_store_dish_daily dd ON dd.store_id = sd.store_id AND dd.dish_id = sd.dish_id AND dd.biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_id, SUM(valid_order_count) AS storeOrderCount FROM analysis_store_daily WHERE biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY store_id ) store_orders ON store_orders.store_id = sd.store_id WHERE AND sd.dish_id IN #{dishId} GROUP BY sd.dish_id, sd.store_id ORDER BY sd.dish_id, sd.store_id

SELECT sd.dish_id AS dishId, d.dish_name AS dishName, COALESCE(MAX(dc.category_name), '未分类') AS categoryName FROM store_dish sd INNER JOIN store_info s ON s.id = sd.store_id INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = sd.dish_id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.master_status = 1 LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON dc.id = COALESCE(sd.category_override_id, d.category_id) WHERE sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.listing_status = 1 AND GROUP BY sd.dish_id, d.dish_name ORDER BY d.dish_name, sd.dish_id

SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, MAX(CASE WHEN sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.listing_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS listed, COALESCE(SUM(dd.sales_quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(dd.net_sales_amount), 0) AS netSales, COALESCE(MAX(store_sales.storeNetSales), 0) AS storeNetSales FROM store_info s LEFT JOIN store_dish sd ON sd.store_id = s.id AND sd.dish_id = #{dishId} LEFT JOIN analysis_store_dish_daily dd ON dd.store_id = s.id AND dd.dish_id = #{dishId} AND dd.biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_amount) AS storeNetSales FROM analysis_store_daily WHERE biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY store_id ) store_sales ON store_sales.store_id = s.id WHERE GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY netSales DESC, salesQuantity DESC, s.store_name, s.id
